claim: QNN-oriented derivatives completed observed text-to-WAV neural paths with CPU fallback disabled, zero CPU provider events, and matching physical HTP executions. This is technical execution evidence, not a quality success or deployment recommendation.

runtime.htp_source_fp_behavior: QNN logs identify FP16 kernels for unquantized source-FP graphs; source tensor types do not establish internal FP32 arithmetic.

fixed_cache_flowlm.design: Six per-layer right-aligned K/V pairs [1,16,256,64], one additive validity mask, absolute RoPE position input, separate 126-frame voice prefill, 26-token text prefill, BOS AR, and latent AR graphs.
fixed_cache_flowlm.limitation: The small recurrent differences accumulated and changed long-run behavior. A separate Android CPU diagnostic of this derivative also reached the 100-frame cap, localizing the drift to derivative arithmetic ordering rather than HTP alone.

mimi_rewrites.design: Remove a proven all-zero encoder Pad, replace two exact erf-GELU chains with com.microsoft.Gelu, bypass NaN cleanup around finite Softmax fixtures, and expose unchanged decoder states directly instead of output Identity nodes.

calibrated_int16_flow.design: Real-prompt QDQ calibration with asymmetric UINT16 activations and symmetric INT16 weights for eligible MatMul, Gemm, and LayerNormalization nodes.

technical_boundary.observed_path: Every neural call actually used in each observed path to produce the listed WAV was QNNExecutionProvider-only and has a one-for-one QNN RPC/accelerator/cycle/HVX record. CPU work was limited to token constants, WAV input/output, RNG, tensor/state ownership, EOS scanning, and orchestration.
technical_boundary.decoder6: The six-frame decoder derivative passed the fallback-disabled host gate but neither explicit-0.7 candidate required or physically invoked it. The technical claim is bounded to each observed 91- or 100-frame path, not every possible tail shape.
technical_boundary.timing: Each candidate has one profiled complete generation. No cold-plus-five-warm distribution or first-audio latency was collected before Moritz stopped further effort; setup includes per-session QNN compilation and profiling overhead.
technical_boundary.memory: VmHWM is cumulative process high-water including ten loaded ORT sessions, model mappings, QNN contexts, caches, buffers, profiles, and output; it is not isolated model memory.
technical_boundary.thermal_battery: Not captured in the completed runs; no laboratory thermal/DVFS control claim is made.

quality.verdict: Moritz rejected the FP-QNN, INT16-QNN, and 0012 CPU samples as unusable.
